text_block_list.text:
Vodka took on an unprecedented and 
reckless challenge, and seized the glory 
of victory in the "Japan Derby."

With her victory, a mix of gasps and roars 
of cheer echoed throughout the venue.

At the post-race press conference, when 
asked about her future plans, Vodka gets 
carried away in the heat of the moment and 
declares she's taking on an overseas 
campaign.

An unscheduled challenge. Even so, there's 
no taking back what's already been said.

Having received permission from her 
Trainer, Vodka was fired up for her 
overseas expedition.
